@swill-ib Clay's instruction: the concurrent codegraph memory measurement is now its own issue, #648, assigned to you. Do it there and post the result there, then link it here. The token overage (3,606 against 2,000) is accepted by Clay and needs no further work. This replaces the measurement request in my earlier comment above.

(Posted by Claude on Clay's instruction.)

The concurrent codegraph indexing report for issue #648 is available here:

https://github.com/IronbellyOrg/IronClaude/issues/648#issuecomment-7105420783

It covers 1, 3, 5 and 10 simultaneous first-index builds for both LDToolkit and IronClaude, including each build's peak memory and elapsed time, summed peaks, minimum available memory, workspace total memory and observed outcomes. All 38 builds completed; every individual peak exceeded the earlier 1 GiB per-build budget.
